description:
I'm a student passionate about space, technology, science, and innovation. I'm developing AEGIS-1 ULTIMATE for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
I'm looking for creative teammates interested in programming, design, science, and space exploration.
Let's share ideas, learn together, and create something amazing!
summary:
Hello! My project is called AEGIS-1 ULTIMATE, developed for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
It is an intelligent dashboard designed to simulate astronaut health monitoring and safety inside a spacecraft.
It tracks heart rate, blood oxygen, blood pressure, body temperature, sleep, stress, and physical activity.
It also monitors oxygen, carbon dioxide, cabin pressure, and space radiation.
The system includes real-time graphics, data history, and three alert levels: normal, warning, and emergency.
It can also simulate solar storms and carbon dioxide leaks, as well as simulate sending mission data to Houston.
The main goal is to help identify risks and improve astronaut safety during space missions.
Thank you!
details:
AEGIS-1 ULTIMATE is a system that simulates astronaut health monitoring and spacecraft conditions. It monitors vital signs, radiation, oxygen and CO2 levels, and sends alerts when problems are detected.
It was developed using HTML, CSS and JavaScript. Its goal is to show how technology can help protect astronauts, prevent risks and improve safety during space missions. Its main feature is a futuristic, interactive dashboard with emergency simulations.
